COS 106 Term Project (20 Marks)
Web Engineering • Multi-Page Responsive Portal

Responsive Student Portfolio & Academic Management Hub

The primary term project for COS 106: Introduction to Web Technologies at Miva Open University. Engineered with strict adherence to semantic HTML5 markup, external CSS3 styling (Flexbox & CSS Grid), mobile-first accessibility standards, and vanilla JavaScript DOM manipulation.

✔ Interactive Task Planner: Full CRUD-capable academic planner persisting to localStorage.
✔ Accessible Audio Console: Dual source (.ogg & .mp3 fallback) with transcript and mute state.
✔ Strict Client-Side Validation: Form input validation ensuring non-empty, email pattern, and digit-only telephone.
✔ Theme Switcher: Cyber-Ops Console (Dark) and Clean Corporate (Light) modes.
Semantic HTML5 CSS Grid CSS Flexbox Vanilla JS ES6 Web Audio API LocalStorage

Cybersecurity Practicum
Defensive Security • Subnet Auditing

Corporate Network Vulnerability & Port Audit Simulator

Designed to simulate corporate security assessments, this project analyzes network ports, inspects live socket responses, captures service banners, and highlights vulnerable open services across simulated subnet environments.

✔ Subnet Scrutiny: Detects unauthorized open management ports (e.g., Telnet, unencrypted HTTP, SMB).
✔ Banner Grabbing: Gathers daemon version strings to identify unpatched vulnerabilities.
✔ Remediation Reporting: Generates executive mitigation summaries and firewall rule recommendations.
Python 3 Socket API Network Security Audit Automation

Identity & Corporate Systems
Corporate Systems • Identity Access Management

Secure Student Authentication & Verification Portal

An interactive security-focused authentication interface modeling modern identity security. Features password entropy evaluation, strict input sanitization to guard against XSS injection, and automated token invalidation.

✔ Entropy Meter: Calculates real-time password strength based on character sets and symbol diversity.
✔ Input Sanitization: Defensive client-side sanitization preventing HTML injection.
✔ Session Expiry: Simulates secure token handling and idle session timeouts.
JavaScript Web Crypto IAM Fundamentals Secure Forms
